authoring.reasoningSummary: Offline concept simulation: Oud-led ingredient storytelling without origin claims. Five invented source signals and two illustrative indices support a carefully limited product-grounded four-shot EN/AR script and a planned pre-produced media/never-sent delivery path.
assumptions: An oud-led sensory visual could interest a conceptual GCC fragrance audience.
Abstract warm gradients and typographic forms can carry sensory associations without invented product photography.
The campaign is a creative sketch rather than a validated brand history.
limitations: No real engagement series or current platform signals have been gathered.
Oud source, extraction process, dates and cultural credentials are not verified.
Arabic wording and sensory nuance need native/brand review.
MP4/poster are pending and frame-rate is a target, not observed.
All platform inputs, plotted indices, execution events and delivery records are fabricated for a labelled Mock POC, not collected, rendered or sent.
Final video and poster are not present; asset bytes/hash/rights are null/pending so the immutable runnable Schema intentionally fails until customer media handoff.
30 fps video metadata is a target specification, not a measured file property.
Simulated delivery records depict counterfactual demo outcomes only; no real email was sent.
